compiled_state.title: Coverage-invariant ledger stability (CF-6: stable cache key, backoff, convergence)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
As a maintainer, I want the review-coverage-invariant ledger to be stable and convergent across CI re-runs so that enforcing it cannot wedge the whole team's promotions on a transient budget/cache miss.

Plan refs: A-3 (CF-6); §4.2.1 ("CF-6 is a HARD precondition of A-5"). Ship independently; warn mode.

DONE DEFINITION:
- DD1: coverage-invariant cache key is stable (drop github.run_id) so re-runs warm-hit the prior ledger. (SC4)
- DD2: ledger is save-always + merged (partial progress persisted), with bounded API backoff and a budget-convergence retryable status (transient 5xx/rate-limit -> retry then block; config-error -> block now). (SC1/SC4)
- DD3: TDD for cache-key stability, ledger merge, and the retry/backoff classifier.

LIVE VERIFICATION + EXPERIMENTS:
- E5: force budget exhaustion mid-walk on a throwaway PR2; re-run -> ledger_hits>0 and converges within K re-runs (no infinite wedge).
- E4: scope-stripped token -> block immediately; simulated transient 5xx -> retry+PASS (do not wedge on one blip).
- Confirm on a live re-run that a previously-walked range is warm-hit (observable in logs).

COURSE-CORRECTION TRIGGER: if the ledger cannot converge within K re-runs under realistic budget pressure, STOP — enforcing a non-convergent check would wedge the team; re-evaluate the budget/backoff design before story 7.

Maps to SC1, SC4. Independent of stories 1/3/4.
